title: The Borrowed Aftermath
author: Edmund Ashgrove
blurb: Freya Thackeray, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
